sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "album_id" TEXT NULL, "album_title" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "artwork_uri" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "content_uri" TEXT NULL, "file_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "modified_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "availability" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "added_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_type", "source_id", "track_id"), CHECK (source_type IN ('local', 'rest')), CHECK (duration_ms >= 0), CHECK (file_size IS NULL OR file_size >= 0), CHECK (availability IN ('available', 'sourceDisabled', 'sourceRemoved', 'localMissing', 'unsupported')), CHECK ((source_type = 'local' AND (local_path IS NOT NULL OR content_uri IS NOT NULL)) OR (source_type = 'rest' AND local_path IS NULL AND content_uri IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "albums" ("album_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "artwork_uri" TEXT NULL, "track_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "album_id"), CHECK (year IS NULL OR year BETWEEN 1 AND 9999), CHECK (track_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "artists" ("artist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "artwork_uri" TEXT NULL, "album_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "track_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "artist_id"), CHECK (album_count >= 0), CHECK (track_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_artists" ("track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_source_type", "track_source_id", "track_id", "artist_source_id", "artist_id"), UNIQUE ("track_source_type", "track_source_id", "track_id", "position"), CHECK (position >= 0), FOREIGN KEY (track_source_type, track_source_id, track_id) REFERENCES tracks (source_type, source_id, track_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (artist_source_id, artist_id) REFERENCES artists (source_id, artist_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "album_artists" ("album_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "album_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "artist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("album_source_id", "album_id", "artist_source_id", "artist_id"), UNIQUE ("album_source_id", "album_id", "position"), CHECK (position >= 0), FOREIGN KEY (album_source_id, album_id) REFERENCES albums (source_id, album_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (artist_source_id, artist_id) REFERENCES artists (source_id, artist_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("playlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "system_type" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("playlist_id"), CHECK (updated_at_ms >= created_at_ms), CHECK ((is_system = 0 AND system_type IS NULL) OR (is_system = 1 AND system_type IS NOT NULL AND system_type IN ('favorites', 'recent', 'queue'))));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_entries" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "playlist_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (playlist_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id"), UNIQUE ("playlist_id", "position"), CHECK (position >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_source_type", "track_source_id", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_history" ("history_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("history_id"), CHECK (last_position_ms >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_entries" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "added_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entry_id"), CHECK (position >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_state" ("singleton_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_entry_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES queue_entries (entry_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton_id"), CHECK (singleton_id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "music_sources" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NULL, "auth_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "credential_ref" TEXT NULL, "public_headers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "endpoints_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "response_mapping_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disconnected', "last_latency_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_tested_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("built_in" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("source_id"), CHECK (source_type IN ('local', 'rest')), CHECK (last_latency_ms IS NULL OR last_latency_ms >= 0), CHECK ((source_type = 'local' AND base_url IS NULL) OR (source_type = 'rest' AND base_url IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_folders" ("folder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "content_uri" TEXT NULL, "grant_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_scanned_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("folder_id"), CHECK (local_path IS NOT NULL OR content_uri IS NOT NULL), CHECK (updated_at_ms >= created_at_ms));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lyrics_cache" ("track_source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "lines_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "translation_language" TEXT NULL, "offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_source_type", "track_source_id", "track_id"), CHECK (kind IN ('plain', 'synchronized')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("search_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "query" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "searched_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("search_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("setting_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("setting_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schema_migrations" ("version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "applied_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("version"), CHECK (version > 0));
CREATE INDEX tracks_by_title ON tracks (title)
CREATE INDEX tracks_by_album ON tracks (source_id, album_id)
CREATE INDEX tracks_by_added ON tracks (added_at_ms DESC, source_type, source_id, track_id)
CREATE INDEX albums_by_title ON albums (title)
CREATE INDEX artists_by_name ON artists (name)
CREATE INDEX playlists_by_updated ON playlists (updated_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX playlist_entries_by_track ON playlist_entries (track_source_type, track_source_id, track_id)
CREATE INDEX favorites_by_added ON favorites (added_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX play_history_by_started ON play_history (started_at_ms)
CREATE INDEX queue_entries_by_track ON queue_entries (track_source_type, track_source_id, track_id)
CREATE INDEX search_history_by_time ON search_history (searched_at_ms)
